mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_order (order_id, store_id, user_id, total_amount, delivery_fee, order_request, status, payment_method, order_type, delivery_address, delivery_detail_address, delivery_phone, delivery_request, created_datetime, created_by) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{storeId}, #{userId}, #{totalAmount}, #{deliveryFee}, #{orderRequest}, #{status}, #{paymentMethod}, #{orderType}, #{deliveryInfo.address}, #{deliveryInfo.detailAddress}, #{deliveryInfo.phone}, #{deliveryInfo.deliveryRequest}, #{createdDatetime}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT idx, order_id, store_id, user_id, review_id, process_yn, message, total_amount, delivery_fee, order_request, status, payment_method, order_type, delivery_address, delivery_detail_address, delivery_phone, delivery_request, created_datetime, updated_datetime, created_by, updated_by FROM tb_order WHERE order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT o.order_id, o.user_id, o.store_id, s.name as store_name, s.phone as store_phone, s.address as store_address, o.status, CASE WHEN o.status = 'PENDING' THEN '주문 접수 대기중' WHEN o.status = 'CONFIRMED' THEN '주문 확인됨' WHEN o.status = 'PREPARING' THEN '음식 준비중' WHEN o.status = 'DELIVERING' THEN '배달중' WHEN o.status = 'DELIVERED' THEN '배달 완료' WHEN o.status = 'CANCELLED' THEN '주문 취소됨' ELSE '확인 중' END as status_description, o.total_amount, o.delivery_fee, o.payment_method, o.order_type, o.order_request, o.delivery_address, o.delivery_detail_address, o.delivery_phone, o.delivery_request, o.created_datetime, CASE WHEN o.status = 'PENDING' THEN '주문 접수 대기중' WHEN o.status = 'CONFIRMED' THEN '30분 - 40분' WHEN o.status = 'PREPARING' THEN '20분 - 30분' WHEN o.status = 'DELIVERING' THEN '10분 - 15분' WHEN o.status = 'DELIVERED' THEN '배달 완료' WHEN o.status = 'CANCELLED' THEN '주문 취소됨' ELSE '확인 중' END as estimated_time FROM tb_order o JOIN tb_store s ON o.store_id = s.id WHERE o.order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_order SET status = #{status}, updated_datetime = NOW() WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
UPDATE tb_order SET status = #{status}, process_yn = #{processYn}, message = #{message}, updated_datetime = NOW(), updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE order_id = #{orderId}
